name: Mining & Metals
challengesDescription: Mining operations often take place in remote, geographically challenging locations with limited road access, extreme weather conditions, and demanding safety requirements. Moving heavy mining equipment — from excavators and haul trucks to conveyor systems and processing plant components — requires careful route planning, specialist transport equipment, and experienced crews.
howWeHelpBody: SSVT Logistics has extensive experience supporting mining and metals operations, from greenfield project construction through ongoing operational logistics. We provide specialised transport for all types of heavy mining equipment, warehouse and distribution services at mine site and regional hub locations, freight forwarding and customs clearance for imported equipment and consumables, and emergency logistics support for critical breakdowns. Our teams have experience working in the most challenging mining environments across multiple regions.

seo.title: Mining & Metals Logistics
seo.description: SSVT provides heavy equipment transport and project logistics for mining operations in remote and challenging locations worldwide.
